程启铭上前一步：“李经理，这次需要的药材准备好了吗？”

李经理说：“程经理放心，都已经准备好了，随时可以装车。”

程启铭对旁边的平三卓说：“师父，我去看一下药材，您老去看看那支人参，行不？”

平三卓点点头：“小野跟我去看看吧！”

“好嘞！师父，我也去长长见识。”

“李经理现在方便吗？”

“先生，您还是叫我小李吧！这要是被我师傅知道了，腿都得给我打折。”

“好好，一个称呼而已。”

“先生请随我来”。

说完就引领着平三卓和王野进入一个办公室，李经理也没有客套，直接就去了办公室旁，在一个带锁的柜子里拿出了一个木盒子，放在茶几上。小心翼翼的打开。对着平三卓说“：先生，您上眼。”

平三卓没有伸手碰盒子，只是弯腰凑上前仔细的观看。

这支百年野山参，算是参中王者。其芦头宛转，仿若游龙，芦碗错落，岁月留痕。主根硕壮，灵秀天成，若仙风道骨之长者，表皮幽黄，恰似古旧之锦缎，细腻而有华光。横纹如刻，深陷若壑，诉说着悠悠岁月的沉淀。

须条纤长且韧，灵动摇曳，珍珠疙瘩星罗棋布，恰似繁星点缀于幽夜之中，每一处细节皆彰显其非凡的生命力与极高的药用尊荣。

平三卓：“不错，不错是支极品。”

李经理深呼了口气：“谢谢先生，您是不知道自从寻到这支参，我是彻夜难眠。您也知道，这种东西肯定是要给上面的，可是我是真的拿不准呀！我师傅这两年眼神越来越不好了，真是不得已才请您过来。今天有您这句话，这让您带走我也放心了。”

平三卓坐回沙发上：“小李呀！这是你的机缘。不说官面上的收获，就说这见识，你在这座千年药都，都可以排得上号了。这支参到你手里也有几天了，相信你已经看的非常仔细了。以后真要是再有这样的机缘，就不用我老头子再跑一趟了。”

李经理笑呵呵的：“还得需要先生指点。”

“你呀！”

然后指了一下王野：“小李，这是我的小徒弟，这次带着他，也是想让他长长见识。一会儿这支参可要打上封条的，再想细看就难喽！不知能不能让他学习学习？”

“看您说的，您要教导徒弟，我在边上不也跟着沾光吗！您随意。”

平三卓对着李经理轻轻点了点头表示谢意。然后就开始给王野讲解起了怎样鉴别人参，那真是事无巨细，深入浅出，一讲就是半个小时。

平三卓面露遗憾：“咳，现在这种好东西是越来越少了。”

Cheng Qiming took a step forward: "Manager Li, are you ready with the medicinal materials needed this time?"

Manager Li said: "Don't worry, Manager Cheng, everything is ready and can be loaded into the car at any time."

Cheng Qiming said to Ping Sanzhuo next to him: "Master, I'm going to look at the medicinal materials. You can go and look at the ginseng, okay?"

Ping Sanzhuo nodded: "Xiao Ye, come with me to have a look!"

"Okay! Master, I'm going to learn more."

"Is it convenient now, Manager Li?"

"Sir, you should call me Xiao Li! If my master finds out about this, my legs will be broken."

"Okay, it's just a title."

"Sir, please follow me."

After saying that, he led Ping Sanzhuo and Wang Ye into an office. Manager Li went directly to the office without being polite, took out a wooden box from a locked cabinet, and placed it on the coffee table.Open it carefully.He said to Ping Sanzhuo, "Sir, please take a look."

Ping Sanzhuo didn't reach out to touch the box, he just bent forward and looked at it carefully.

This century-old wild ginseng is considered the king of ginseng.The reed heads are swaying like a swimming dragon, and the reed bowls are scattered here and there, leaving traces of time.The main root is strong, graceful and natural, like an elder with immortal spirit. The skin is yellowish, just like ancient brocade, delicate and lustrous.The horizontal lines are like carvings and the deep valleys are like ravines, telling the story of the long years of precipitation.

The whiskers are slender and tough, swaying flexibly, and the pearl knots are scattered all over the place, just like the stars dotted in the night. Every detail shows its extraordinary vitality and high medicinal honor.

Ping Sanzhuo: "Yes, yes, it is the best."

Manager Li took a deep breath: "Thank you, sir. You don't know that I have been unable to sleep all night since I found this ginseng. You also know that this kind of thing must be given to the higher-ups, but I am really not sure! My master's eyesight has become worse and worse in the past two years, so I have no choice but to ask you to come here. With your words today, I feel relieved that you can take it away."

Ping Sanzhuo sat back on the sofa: "Xiao Li! This is your opportunity. Not to mention the official gains, let's talk about this knowledge, you can be ranked high in this thousand-year medicine capital. It has been in your hands for a few days, and I believe you have looked at it very carefully. If there is such an opportunity again in the future, there is no need for my old man to make another trip."

Manager Li smiled and said: "I still need some guidance from my husband."

"You!"

Then he pointed at Wang Ye: "Xiao Li, this is my little apprentice. I am taking him with me this time because I want him to learn more. This ginseng will have to be sealed soon, and it will be difficult to take a closer look! I wonder if I can let him learn?"

"Look what you said, if you want to teach your disciples, why don't I also take advantage of it? It's up to you."

Ping Sanzhuo nodded gently to Manager Li to express his gratitude.Then he began to explain to Wang Ye how to identify ginseng. It was very detailed and explained in simple terms, and the lecture lasted half an hour.

Ping Sanzhuo looked regretful: "Well, there are fewer and fewer good things like this now."
